title: Flaky: Node/Deno app functional tests fail with InitializeAsync timeout on windows-latest
job_name: Tests / No-package tests (regular, Aspire.Hosting.JavaScript.Tests, Hosting.JavaScript, Hosting.JavaScrip... / Hosting.JavaScript (windows-latest)
error_pattern:

---- System.Threading.Tasks.TaskCanceledException : A task was canceled.
   at Aspire.Hosting.Dcp.DcpExecutor.CreateRenderedResourcesAsync[TDcpResource,TContext](...) in DcpExecutor.cs:line 966
analysis: Both VerifyNodeAppWorks and VerifyNpmAppWorks fail identically with NodeAppFixture.InitializeAsync throwing TaskCanceledException from DcpExecutor.CreateRenderedResourcesAsync on windows-latest. The PR under analysis (#20152) only modifies VS Code extension files and has no relation to Aspire.Hosting.JavaScript.Tests or the DCP executor, confirming this is unrelated startup timing flakiness rather than a code regression.
